universe.note: All people are fictional; companies, schools, cities and industries are real.

edgeCases.description: Different people (different URLs) with identical full names in one file; name-only joins must treat them as ambiguous.
Different people sharing a full name across two datasets; entity resolution must use the profile URL.
Names needing CSV quoting or Unicode handling: embedded double quotes, apostrophes, commas in last names (credentials/suffixes), diacritics, hyphens, a CJK name with a percent-encoded profile slug.

details.name: María José de la Cruz Ortega

edgeCases.description: Rows with blank Company and/or Position (hidden current role, no current role).
Current employer is Self-employed / Freelance / Stealth Startup / Independent Consultant / Open to work / Retired (or a variant).
Titles with ALL CAPS, pipes, emoji, double spaces, leading spaces (trimmed by the parser), commas and embedded quotes.
Company cells that need CSV quoting (e.g. "Bain & Company, Inc.", "Block, Inc.", "Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom").
Vanity slugs written with capitals in Connections.csv but lowercase in messages/invitations; joins must normalize case.
Endorsement URLs are written without scheme (www.linkedin.com/in/<slug>), Notes URLs with a trailing slash; both normalize to linkedin.com/in/<slug>.
Pre-2020 header "First Name,Last Name,Email Address,Company,Position,Connected On" with no URL column and no Notes preamble; C08 also uses M/D/YY dates.
Classic file starting with a UTF-8 BOM (FORMAT.md 1.3: stripped by parseCsvRfc4180).
Every file sits under Complete_LinkedInDataExport_<MM-DD-YYYY>/ inside the zip.
Basic-shaped export: Connections, messages, Invitations, Profile, Positions, Education, Skills only (plus 8 non-whitelisted files).
messages.csv has the 12th IS MESSAGE DRAFT column; TRUE rows are skipped (including 2 draft-only conversations).
FOLDER=SPAM rows are skipped; N03 also has SPAM threads from connections.
Zip without messages.csv: ownerDetected must be null and no message fields on rows.

messages.csv never shows the owner's own URL (blank SENDER PROFILE URL on owner rows, owner omitted from RECIPIENT PROFILE URLS); every non-connection URL appears in exactly one conversation, so URL detection ties and fails and the importer falls back to the Profile.csv name.
Conversations with more than 5 non-owner participants are ignored for every counter.
Sponsored messages from company pages (non-/in/ sender URL) and recruiter InMail from non-connections; neither credits a connection.
Pending invitations to/from non-connections (dropped), blank-URL rows joined by unique name, an older opposite-direction row where the latest-dated row wins, ambiguous-name rows dropped.

Multiple notes per connection concatenated, one note > 500 chars (capped), multi-line note (collapsed), blank note (skipped), note for a non-connection and for an ambiguous name (dropped), blank-URL name joins.
PENDING/REJECTED rows not counted (one endorser has only PENDING rows => endorsementCount 0), blank-URL rows joined by unique name, endorsers who are not connections dropped.
Name-only join: non-VISIBLE rows leave recommendedYou false, an ambiguous-name VISIBLE row and a non-connection VISIBLE row are dropped.
NETWORK_CONTEXT_CAPS exercised: N01 Company Follows.csv has 216 rows (one duplicate) => 200 followedCompanies; N07 Skills.csv has 57 rows (one case-duplicate) => 50 skills.
The same person shows a different employer/title in two exports taken at different dates (see expected_graph.json jobChangesAcrossSnapshots).
Owner-to-owner connections appear in both owners' files with the same Connected On date.
Emails use example.com/.net/.org, phone numbers use 555-01xx, IPs use documentation ranges.
